{{Quote|Yow. Their field must've gone critical. Probably slipped a superconductor coupling|A Clone trooper lieutenant referring the the explosion of a Bota transport|<ref name="MI:BS" />}}
'''Superconductor couplings''' were a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] part available in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were used in [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Bota/Legends|bota]] transport ships where they were housed with [[vacuum bubble]]s. When one of the transports exploded over [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the [[Battle of Drongar]] a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] theorised it may have been due to the superconductor couplings slipping and causing the ship to go critical. An [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] disputed the claim however stating his crew had checked the couplings housings and that the vacuum bubble seals were tight.<ref name="MI:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Superconductor couplings first appeared in [[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]], the first book in the [[MedStar Duology]] written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] which was published in [[2004]].<ref name="MI:BS" />
